Axiom:
**V2 files carry one semantic owner; task relations come from the deterministic resolver.**
Required file-level fields in execution profile: - `@file` — mandatory; what the file holds. - `@spec` — mandatory; exactly one stable canonical Spec ID, never a path. - `@consumers` — mandatory; one or more named consumers from the owning spec.
`@tasks` is legacy V1 migration evidence and is forbidden in a new or migrated V2 header. `planned`, `active`, `blocked`, and `history` task relations are resolved from exact ticket targets and lifecycle state; none is copied into the header. Only an `active` relation may continue/recover under task state policy. `history` is context, never routing authority.
Canonical header shape: ``` // @file: // @spec: // @consumers: ```
